messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#PDR14321 - prom-scrape-job-failure rate 12/min across prometheus-cluster-01. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PDR14321 :rotating_light:

sam: saw the autopage, pulling in oncall

pagerduty-bot: Incident PDR14321 assigned to @ops-oncall

ops-oncall: acking, on it. what's the scope? any customer-facing impact?

tara: looks like prometheus scrape error spike across node-exporter targets, 503s from exporter pods

riju: seeing redispatch errors on log-ingest as well, kafka consumer group lag increasing for logs-topic

sam: possible common cause = recent config push to monitoring relabels 02:10UTC? cc @kai

kai: I rolled out relabel patch 02:09, but only to canary, didn't expect global impact. checking canary logs

julie: product oncall flagged stale metrics for some dashboards, customers reported missing data in Alerting UI

ops-oncall: running quick checks
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=prometheus -o wide
kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/node-exporter --since=20m | tail -n 200
```

ops-oncall: node-exporter pods showing 500 errors and OOMKilled on two nodes, java heap? weird

riju: kafka consumer lag: group=log-ingest-consumer lag ~120k, producers backed up, ingestion throttle

tara: acked PD and escalated to SRE lead

sam: immediate mitigation: scale prom scrape workers and restart node-exporter daemonset on impacted nodes

ops-oncall: executing
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring scale deployment/prom-scrape-workers --replicas=8
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart daemonset/node-exporter
```

kai: reverting relabel config on canary to previous sha to test

pagerduty-bot: PDR14321 acknowledged by ops-oncall (tara)

julie: notifying customer-facing teams: slack #support and sending note to oncall@customers

product-oncall: which customers affected? we have alerts for acme-inc and beta-co

sam: ACME dashboards stale since 02:12UTC, Beta-co intermittent missing series

ops-oncall: scaled scrapers up, restarted exporters on 3 nodes, tailing logs now

riju: kafka consumer replicas scaled too
```bash
kubectl -n ingest scale deployment/log-ingest-consumer --replicas=6
```

ops-oncall: seeing scrape error rate drop, consumer lag decreasing

tara: prometheus shows scrape_error_count back to baseline on most targets, some residual 500s on node-17

ops-oncall: node-17 rebooting due to OOM, replacing node, moving pods off

sam: PD incident timeline: fired 02:14, ack 02:20, mitigations applied 02:30, recovery 02:36

julie: customer impact: ACME (partial dashboard gaps ~24m), Beta-co (~10m), no data loss, just delayed ingestion. raising RCA

kai: root cause preliminary: relabel config combined with exporter memory leak triggered OOMs under load; relabel caused different scrape pattern increasing memory for exporters

sam: will follow up with full postmortem, assign action items: revert relabel change in prod, add unit test to relabel rollout, increase exporter pod memory and add restart threshold monitor

ops-oncall: closing PD incident, marking resolved

pagerduty-bot: Incident PDR14321 resolved by ops-oncall

sam: thanks all — create postmortem ticket and tag eng-sre, eng-ml (since monitors touch model infra), cc product

julie: I sent note to customers and support with ETA and impact summary :white_check_mark:

kai: pushing revert PR now and will open follow-up for resource limits and canary gating

sam: good job, we'll schedule a blameless postmortem tomorrow 10:00am UTC
